nodes.label: Building shadow
nodes.description: Total accrued shadow. In New York this is dominated by building shadow: it correlates -0.39 with canopy cover and -0.48 with open space, peaking in street canyons with neither. Formerly drawn as 'Urban shading' fed by trees and canopy, which did not describe this measurement.
